goal: The docs for core, cli and web match release 3.0, follow docs/STYLE.md, and docs/index.md links every page; done when the link check passes

steps.title: Write the style guide and page list
steps.proof: docs/STYLE.md lists the heading order, the tone rules and every page each package must have

steps.title: Rewrite the core package docs
steps.proof: npm run docs:check -- packages/core passes and every page in docs/STYLE.md for core exists

steps.title: Rewrite the cli package docs
steps.proof: npm run docs:check -- packages/cli passes and every command in cli --help has a page

steps.title: Rewrite the web package docs
steps.proof: npm run docs:check -- packages/web passes and every page in docs/STYLE.md for web exists

steps.title: Update the docs index and check links
steps.proof: docs/index.md links every package page and npm run docs:links reports 0 broken links
